intellectual_tradition: Last master of the eastern-Zhejiang (Zhedong) school; founder of Chinese historiography of historiography and gazetteer studies; 'all the Six Classics are history'; from Kuaiji, Shaoxing, Zhejiang
school: 浙东学派/史学史与方志学奠基人
historical_significance: 章学诚（1738—1801），字实斋，浙江会稽（今绍兴）人，清代史学家、思想家，浙东学派殿军。一生科举蹭蹬、依人幕府，却以「六经皆史」一语重估全部经典传统：六经不过是先王政典的记录，道在事中，不在空言。他开创中国的史学史与方志学：区分「撰述」（圆神、成一家之言）与「记注」（方智、史官成法），在刘知几才学识三长之上补出「史德」一目，主张「辨心术以议史德」；方志学上立「三书」体（志、掌故、文征），设志科为常设档案机构，使方志从地理书升格为一代全史。其「别识心裁」与「通史家风」深刻影响近代史学（梁启超、何炳松、胡适皆推重之），并与戴震「由词通道」构成清代思想的双峰对峙。
core_thoughts: 六经皆史（经即先王政典，道在事中）
撰述与记注之分（圆神与方智、成一家之言与史官成法）
史德论（辨心术以议史德，慎辨于天人之际）
别识心裁（独断之学与考索之功之分）
道器不离（道在器中，即器存道）
辨章学术、考镜源流（校雠学即知识谱系学）
方志立三书（志、掌故、文征——一方全史）
famous_quote: 六经皆史也。古人不著书，古人未尝离事而言理，六经皆先王之政典也。
influence: 章学诚生前寂寞，身后其学渐显：梁启超推为「清代唯一之史学大师」；胡适作《章实斋年谱》、何炳松译介其学，使「六经皆史」与「撰述/记注」之分进入近代史学方法论；其方志三书体成为后世修志范式；「辨章学术，考镜源流」被目录学、学术史与知识组织学科奉为圭臬。与乾嘉考据主流相对，他代表「由史见道」的另一路径，与戴震「由词通道」构成清代方法论的两极——一由语言通义理，一由史事通道体。

mode_evidence.evidence_zh: 《文史通义·易教上》：六经皆史也。古人不著书，古人未尝离事而言理，六经皆先王之政典也。
mode_evidence.evidence_en: All the Six Classics are history. The ancients did not 'author books'; they never spoke of principle apart from affairs; the Six Classics are all governmental records of former kings.
mode_evidence.source: 六经皆史也。古人不著书，古人未尝离事而言理，六经皆先王之政典也。

mode_evidence.evidence_zh: 《文史通义·书教下》：《尚书》圆而神，其于史也，可谓天之至矣；《春秋》方以智，即宪章祖述之义也。迁书体圆用神，班氏体方用智。
mode_evidence.evidence_en: The Documents are round and spiritual—the utmost of history; the Spring and Autumn is square and wise. Sima Qian's Shiji embodies roundness with spirit; Ban Gu's Hanshu squareness with wisdom.
mode_evidence.source: 《尚书》圆而神，其于史也，可谓天之至矣；《春秋》方以智，即宪章祖述之义也。迁书体圆用神，班氏体方用智。

mode_evidence.evidence_zh: 《文史通义·史德》：能具史识者，必知史德。德者何？谓著书者之心术也。慎辨于天人之际，尽其天而不益以人。
mode_evidence.evidence_en: Whoever possesses historical insight must know historical virtue. What is virtue? The rectitude of the writer's heart... Carefully discern the boundary between the natural and the human: exhaust the natural and add nothing human.
mode_evidence.source: 能具史识者，必知史德。德者何？谓著书者之心术也。慎辨于天人之际，尽其天而不益以人。

mode_evidence.evidence_zh: 《文史通义·答客问上》：独断之学，非是不为功；考索之功，非是不为密。高明者由大略而切求，沉潜者循度数而徐达。
mode_evidence.evidence_en: Original judgment achieves nothing without this; investigative labor achieves no precision without this... The bold proceed from broad outline to exacting inquiry; the thorough advance slowly through measured degrees.
mode_evidence.source: 独断之学，非是不为功；考索之功，非是不为密。高明者由大略而切求，沉潜者循度数而徐达。

mode_evidence.evidence_zh: 《文史通义·原道中》：道不离器，犹影不离形也。夫天下岂有离器言道、离形存影者哉？
mode_evidence.evidence_en: Dao does not leave its vessel, as shadow does not leave its form. Is there anywhere in the world a Dao discussed apart from vessels, a shadow preserved apart from its shape?
mode_evidence.source: 道不离器，犹影不离形也。夫天下岂有离器言道、离形存影者哉？

mode_evidence.evidence_zh: 《校雠通义·叙》：校雠之义，盖自刘向父子，部次条别，将以辨章学术，考镜源流。
mode_evidence.evidence_en: The meaning of bibliographic collation, from Liu Xiang and his son onward, is to order and classify so as to delineate scholarship and mirror its sources.
mode_evidence.source: 校雠之义，盖自刘向父子，部次条别，将以辨章学术，考镜源流。

mode_evidence.evidence_zh: 《方志立三书议》：凡欲经纪一方之文献，必立三家之学，而始可以通古人之遗意也。仿纪传之体而作志，仿律令典例之体而作掌故，仿文选文苑之体而作文征。
mode_evidence.evidence_en: To manage the records of a region one must establish three learning-tracks: a chronicle after the annals-biography form, institutional records after the statute form, and a literary collection after the anthology form.
mode_evidence.source: 凡欲经纪一方之文献，必立三家之学，而始可以通古人之遗意也。仿纪传之体而作志，仿律令典例之体而作掌故，仿文选文苑之体而作文征。

mode_evidence.evidence_zh: 《文史通义·答客问上》/《释通》：通史之修，其为用有二：一则仍守先正成法，述而不作；一则通古今之变，成一家之言。史以事义为经，不以朝代为断。
mode_evidence.evidence_en: General history serves either to transmit the received method without invention, or to comprehend change across ages and achieve one's own voice... History is threaded by affairs and meanings, not cut by dynasties.
mode_evidence.source: 通史之修，其为用有二：一则仍守先正成法，述而不作；一则通古今之变，成一家之言。史以事义为经，不以朝代为断。

mode_evidence.evidence_zh: 《文史通义·文德》：凡为古文辞者，必敬以恕。敬非修德之谓，而所以执事；恕非宽容之谓，而所以论文。论古必恕，非宽容之谓也。
mode_evidence.evidence_en: Whoever writes must be reverent and forbearing. Reverence is not moral cultivation but the discipline of one's task; forbearance is not leniency but the way of judging writings... To judge antiquity one must be forbearing — not in the sense of indulgence.
mode_evidence.source: 凡为古文辞者，必敬以恕。敬非修德之谓，而所以执事；恕非宽容之谓，而所以论文。论古必恕，非宽容之谓也。

mode_evidence.evidence_zh: 《文史通义·原学》/《家书》：学者不可无宗主，而必不可有门户。
mode_evidence.evidence_en: A scholar must have a master-tradition but must never form a faction.
mode_evidence.source: 学者不可无宗主，而必不可有门户。

cross_references.description_zh: 戴震由词通道（训诂明而后义理明），章学诚由史见道（六经皆史、道在事中）——同为反宋明空言之实证路线，戴自语言文字入，章自史事制度入，构成清代方法论双峰。
cross_references.description_en: Dai Zhen reaches the Way through words (philology first), Zhang Xuecheng through history (the classics are records of affairs) — both empirical anti-empty-talk routes, one via language, one via institutions. The two were rivals in life (Zhang criticized Dai's lexicon) yet twin peaks in method.

cross_references.description_zh: 顾炎武立考据学方法（音韵证经、采铜于山）而以经学为归；章学诚承浙东史学，以史学统经学，强调别识心裁与成一家之言——顾重功夫之实，章重别裁之神。
cross_references.description_en: Gu Yanwu founded evidential method subordinated to classical studies; Zhang, heir of the eastern-Zhejiang historiographical school, subsumes classics under history and prizes independent insight — Gu values laborious verification, Zhang creative synthesis.

cross_references.description_zh: 章学诚为浙东学派殿军，承黄宗羲「学必原本于经术」而后文史学一脉；黄创学案体以明学术流变，章以「辨章学术、考镜源流」将其升级为系统的知识谱系学。
cross_references.description_en: Zhang as the last master of the eastern-Zhejiang school inherits Huang Zongxi's union of classics and history; Huang's case-history genre is systematized by Zhang into a full genealogy of knowledge.

modern_value_zh: 六经皆史——权威文本历史化：一切「经典」先还原为其时代的运作记录再谈义理
撰述记注二分——数据层与创作层分工：原始资料严守体例留存，观点写作须有别识心裁
史德养心——写作前先审动机：识别「似公实私」，以事实为量不以己意为量
辨章学术考镜源流——知识组织即研究方法：用谱系结构显出盲区与断层
方志三书——三层知识架构：叙事、制度档案、原始文献各自独立又互相印证
文德敬恕——理解先于评判：批评前先重建对方处境，不以后见之明苛责
modern_value_en: All classics are history: historicize 'authoritative texts' as operational records of their era before discussing doctrine
Composition vs. registration: separate the data layer (strict conventions) from the creation layer (independent insight)
Historical virtue: audit motive before writing — detect 'seemingly impartial yet privately motivated' prose; measure by facts, not intent
Genealogy of knowledge: organization as research method — let lineage structure expose blind spots and lost branches
Gazetteer three books: three-layer knowledge architecture — narrative, institutional archive, primary documents, independent yet mutually verifying
Reverence and forbearance: understanding precedes judgment — reconstruct the author's situation before critique, never judge by hindsight
unique_thing: Zhang Xuecheng's core achievement was 'reducing the canon to history and founding the study of how knowledge itself is organized.' Failing the examinations all his life and living on patrons' stipends, he nonetheless rebuilt the entire classical tradition on one proposition — the Six Classics are records of governance, the Dao resides in affairs. He invented China's historiography of historiography (composition vs. registration, historical virtue as the heart's rectitude), upgraded bibliography into a genealogy of knowledge ('delineate the scholarship, mirror its sources'), and gave localities a standing archival institution. Where Dai Zhen reached the Way through words, Zhang reached it through institutions — making him, in Liang Qichao's verdict, the only true master of historical method in the Qing: every big tradition audited by the affairs that once carried it.
